% Shared normative validity and edge-case behavior.
\section{Validity, unavailable states, and edge cases}\label{sec:validity}

\begin{longtable}{@{}p{0.18\linewidth}p{0.38\linewidth}p{0.36\linewidth}@{}}
\toprule
ID & Unavailable quantity or claim & Release condition or disposition \\

SCI-POINT-UNAV-019 & Signed fitted-amplitude/full-map-RMS diagnostic and \texttt{sig2noise} alias & UNAV-017 released, compatible selected signed fit-amplitude role and parent generation, positive finite denominator, claim-appropriate association, and proof of mathematical identity plus explicit alias approval. \\
SCI-POINT-UNAV-020 & \path{known}/\path{isolated}/\path{bright}/\path{approximately_centered} fact & Exact fact authority or test and cause. \\

\subsection{Edge-case rules}\label{sec:edge-rules}

\begin{longtable}{@{}p{0.34\linewidth}p{0.59\linewidth}@{}}
\toprule
Condition & Required behavior \\
\midrule
\endhead
Missing method, boundary, input, or applicability authority & The dependent quantity is \texttt{unavailable} with identity and cause; no default is inferred. \\
Attempted computation cannot conform & Report \texttt{failed}; do not relabel it scientifically unavailable. \\
Missing or non-finite admitted support & Apply the future compatibility method's exact failure/unavailability rule; preserve only reached lifecycle stages and the exact terminal \path{unavailable}, \path{failed}, or \path{not_produced} outcome; never fabricate applied/fit-realized evidence or silently delete rows. \\
Active parameter bound & Report the constraint and \texttt{available\_bound\_censored} where applicable. \\
Weak curvature or near degeneracy & Report \texttt{weakly\_identified}; formal error may be unavailable independently of the fitted value. \\
Exact circularity & Orientation is \texttt{undefined\_by\_model\_symmetry}. \\
Major/minor exchange & Enforce canonical ordering and transform orientation consistently without changing the invariant model. \\
Centroid on a search or fit boundary & Report boundary/constraint state; named-use eligibility is evaluated separately. \\
Rank-deficient or non-positive curvature & Formal error is unavailable unless the future exact method defines another conforming result; fit-component state is assessed separately. \\
Unmodeled constant, gradient, or structure & Preserve residual and parent additive-reference state; do not fit or silently subtract it. \\
Association unavailable or failed & A numerical fit may remain a diagnostic, but source-attributed amplitude and displacement are unavailable. \\
Missing profile, source binding, or resolved structural scope & For a written accounting artifact, request is \path{requested}, applicability is \path{applicability_unknown}, eligibility is \path{decision_unavailable}, and realization is \path{realized}; preserve producer facts. \\
Structural named-use conflict & A faithfully written decision artifact may record the conflict with realization \path{realized}; use \path{failed} only if production of the artifact fails. \\
Named use not requested & Request is \path{not_requested}; applicability and eligibility have no proposition; realization is \path{not_produced}. \\
Requested use known inapplicable & For a written decision artifact, applicability is \path{inapplicable}, eligibility has no proposition, and realization is \path{realized}. \\
Incomplete, failed, or absent requested artifact & Use realization \path{incomplete}, \path{failed}, or \path{not_produced}, respectively; the defective or absent artifact makes no authoritative eligibility assertion. \\
Zero or non-finite diagnostic denominator & Ratio is unavailable or failed under its future exact method, never infinite. \\
Unavailable response or covariance & Preserve its exact identity/status and follow the dependency matrix; do not erase amplitude, centroid, displacement, or other independent facts, and do not authorize a dependent claim. \\
Incomparable response outputs & Report response unavailable or a typed discontinuity/state transition with branch, gauge, component, cause, and provenance; never subtract lifecycle objects or coerce incomparable numerical products. \\
One array unavailable or failed & Preserve sibling atomic products; publish no POINT observation-wide success. \\
Terminal-FRUIT assertion absent, or intermediate iteration & Reject the parent for base v0.1. \\
Requested route unavailable & Do not choose, substitute, or fall back to another parent route. \\
Diagnostic-display action present & Preserve the four named-use fields; the action cannot rescue any other exclusion. \\
One fit component unavailable or failed & Preserve every conforming sibling role and the complete value-or-status atom. \\
Published per-array product & Inherit parent observation/exposure lineage or record typed \path{not_applicable}; POINT creates no exposure identity and no cross-array independence assumption. \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}
